verdict.rationale: Martin ships specific recurring background tasks: daily or weekly email briefings and a wake-up call at a set time every morning. It also offers time-based reminders and custom shortcuts that trigger multi-step actions. The evidence never shows a general way to put arbitrary workflows or shortcuts on a recurring schedule, so recurrence is limited to these preset task types. Missing for 10: user-defined recurring schedules for arbitrary jobs/workflows, scheduled triggering of shortcuts, documented recurrence for reminders, independent hands-on corroboration.
